description: This PHP source file defines the Theme class for writing spreadsheet theme data to Excel's XLSX format in XML. It includes methods for serializing theme elements such as color schemes, font schemes, and formatting schemes into XML structure.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Handles writing theme information (colors, fonts, styles) to XML for XLSX spreadsheet files.

methods.name: writeTheme
methods.description: Serializes the Spreadsheet theme into XML format using XMLWriter.

methods.name: writeFonts
methods.description: Outputs font scheme data into XML, including Latin, East Asian, Complex Script, and substitutions.

methods.name: writeColourScheme
methods.description: Serializes the color scheme of the theme into XML elements.
